subject: English
passage: Composer Gabriela Lena Frank draws on her Peruvian heritage to create works that blend indigenous Andean and Western classical traditions. Her opera co-written with playwright Nilo ______ was premiered by San Diego Opera and later staged by San Francisco Opera.
prompt: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
explanation:
Choice A is the best answer. The convention being tested is punctuation use between a subject and a verb. No punctuation is needed when, as in this case, a subject ("Her opera co-written with playwright Nilo Cruz") is immediately followed by a main verb ("was premiered").

Why C is incorrect:

Choice C is incorrect because a dash can't be used in this way to separate a subject from its verb.
